latest_release.name: v8.2.0-RC1
latest_release.body:
**Changelog** (https://github.com/symfony/console/compare/v8.2.0-BETA2...v8.2.0-RC1)

 * bug #68398  Allow zero as table padding character (@malekkadri)
 * bug #68382  Fix handling of zero option shortcuts (@malekkadri)
 * bug #68376  Restore formatter decoration state on exceptions (@malekkadri)
 * bug #68381  Retry alarms that interrupt an autoload instead of wrapping the autoloader (@nicolas-grekas)
 * bug #68314  Fix "Class not found" when a signal handler needs a class being autoloaded (@Inf1mum)
 * minor #68342  Fix the `tty` group of `TerminalInputHelperTest` (@nicolas-grekas)
 * bug #68332  Fix how date arguments and options are resolved (@nicolas-grekas)
 * bug #68284  Fix `#` on `#` properties (@nicolas-grekas)
 * bug #68283  Fix `#` on `#` properties and out-of-range `bool|int` options (@nicolas-grekas)
 * bug #68282  Fix validation of int-backed enums and numeric union options in invokable commands (@prateekbhujel)
 * bug #68265  Fix the symfony/polyfill-php85 requirement and add tests for CombinedOutput (@pawell67)
 * bug #68258  Fix default values of promoted properties in `#` DTOs (@pawell67)
 * bug #68234  Stop rendering `PHP_BINARY` in `command.invocation` (@nicolas-grekas)
 * bug #68237  Fix hydrating readonly properties of `#` DTOs (@nicolas-grekas)
 * bug #68216  Fix `InputFile` with `file://` URIs that contain `5C` or a host name (@nicolas-grekas)
 * bug #68188  Escape file names and messages in the output of the lint commands (@nicolas-grekas)
 * bug #68189  Escape the output of `lint:expressions` and write the GitLab report raw (@nicolas-grekas)
 * bug #68179  Fix file:// URI handling in InputFile (@Tong-bit-art)

Console Component
=================

The Console component eases the creation of beautiful and testable command line
interfaces.

Sponsor
-------

This package is looking for a [backer][1].
